   colony 2 (well B1 in slot 4), colony 10 (well B2 in slot 4) and 12 more while it still
   carried pcr mix (tube A1 in slot 2), colony 1 (well A1 in slot 4), colony 9 (well A2 in
   slot 4), colony 2 (well B1 in slot 4) and 12 more from an earlier step (this line did it
